verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs repeatedly claim global payroll capability—paying employees and contractors worldwide, worldwide tax calculation/filing, and unified global HR/payroll management (rippling-docs-16, -17, -40, -50, -46)—which supports employing people abroad. However, none of the evidence explicitly mentions an Employer-of-Record (EOR) service or clarifies whether this relies on owned local entities versus a partner EOR model, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of successful cross-border hiring compliance. Missing for 10: explicit EOR service description, entity-ownership details per country, and third-party validation of global compliance handling.
